title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 091
review_goal: Differentiate task, telescope, and thumb down variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Clipboard panel with one top clip and one large check mark in the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the task cue to read as a completed clipboard item with a check mark.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the list clipboard when the panel should show horizontal task lines instead of one big check mark.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot centers the clipboard on a large check mark rather than list bars.

items.depicts_observation: Clipboard panel with one top clip and three horizontal list bars down the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the task cue to read as a list of items on a clipboard.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the checked clipboard when the panel should not be dominated by one large check mark.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot fills the clipboard with list bars instead of one big completion check.

items.depicts_observation: Long telescope body tilted on one tripod stand with the eyepiece pointing toward the upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an observing scope mounted on a stand rather than a handheld viewing tool.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the binoculars when the viewing tool should split into two barrels with two eyepieces.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one long scope mounted on a stand instead of two short binocular barrels.

items.depicts_observation: Pair of binocular barrels joined at the center with two round eyepieces at the lower ends
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a dual barrel handheld viewing tool instead of a mounted telescope.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tripod telescope when the sighting tool should not be one long angled tube on a stand.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot splits the viewing tool into two joined barrels rather than one mounted scope.

items.depicts_observation: Thumb silhouette pointing downward with one rounded back and one short cuff nub on the left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a compact rounded thumbs down shape without a long separate wrist block.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the more structured thumbs down hand when the wrist and palm should look more segmented.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reads as the rounder compact thumbs down instead of the more segmented hand silhouette.
